title: Bombay High Court fines State ₹5 lakh for arguing IIT Powai soil case on non-existent law
description: The Bombay High Court recently slapped the Maharashtra government with costs of ₹5 lakh for dragging contractor IVRCL through almost a decade of avoidable litigation over earth excavated within the IIT Bombay campus by invoking a non‑existent law and a misconceived penalty provision. [IVRCL Ltd v. State of Maharashtra & Ors]Justice Kamal Khata held that the show‑cause notice itself suffered from a fundamental jurisdictional defect because it cited Section 29(4) of the Mumbai Minor Minerals A
